use_headerbar.description: Use headerbar layout (client side decorations) instead of traditional titlebar/toolbar.

use_toolbar.description: Use toolbar layout (server side decorations) instead of headerbar.

verbose.description: Enable verbose/debug output when launching the application.

language.description: Locale code for the application interface.

default_category.description: Default FDO category assigned to newly created launcher entries.

ignored_directories.description: List of directory paths to exclude from menu scanning. Items should be relative paths or full paths depending on implementation context, but typically relative to user config for this template structure. Example: ['.local/share/applications/ignored/']
